value: In substantial breadbasket areas climate explains over 60% of yield variability.

value: Most harvesting regions show a climate influence on yields.
quote: However, the vast majority of crop harvesting regions did experience the influence of climate variability on crop yields: ~70% of maize harvesting regions, ~53% of rice harvesting regions, ~79% of wheat harvesting regions and ~67% of soybean harvesting regions.

value: Climate explains ~41% of maize yield variability in the major grain belts.

value: Climate explains ~32% of rice yield variability globally.
